name: Reminder by Dizetech
author: DIZE TECH IT SOLUTIONS

sections.description:
Are you tired of forgetting important dates, domain renewals, or client deadlines?

Reminder by Dizetech is a powerful, yet simple-to-use plugin that integrates directly into your WordPress dashboard. Create one-time reminders for any event—birthdays, anniversaries, subscription renewals, or project deadlines.

You can configure a simple notification to be sent to your admin email or a client’s email before or after the event. This plugin is designed to be lightweight and feel like a native part of WordPress, using a Custom Post Type to manage all your reminders.

It’s the perfect to-do list and task scheduler right inside WordPress.

Free Features:

  • Create Unlimited Reminders: Add as many one-time reminders as you need.
  • Simple Event Details: Add an event date, time (with 12-hour picker), and private notes.
  • Flexible Notification Setup: Create one or more notifications per reminder (e.g., “1 week before” and “1 day before”).
  • Admin & Client Emails: Choose to notify the site admin, a custom client email address, or both.
  • Template Importer: Load your default Admin or Client templates with a single click.
  • Reminder Dashboard: A beautiful, modern dashboard showing your stats: Total Reminders, Coming in 30 Days, Total Reminded, and Drafts.
  • Custom Reminder Categories: Organize your reminders with their own categories.
  • Customizable Columns: A clean “All Reminders” table showing Title, Category, Created Date, and Status.
  • Customizable Settings: Set your default “From” name/email, default notification time, and default email templates.

Go Pro and Unlock the Full Power of Reminders!

Reminders Pro turns your simple notification tool into a complete automation and public-facing event platform.

  • ✅ Recurring Reminders: Set reminders to repeat daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly. Perfect for subscriptions and anniversaries!
  • ✅ Public Event Management: Create public-facing events (webinars, parties, etc.) with their own pages.
  • ✅ Event Countdown Timers: Build excitement with a beautiful countdown timer on your event pages.
  • ✅ Event Registration Forms: Allow users to register for your public events with a simple form.
  • ✅ Automated Event Reminders: Automatically email all registered attendees 24 hours before the event.
  • ✅ SMS Reminders: Send reminders directly to any phone via SMS integration.
  • ✅ WhatsApp Integration: Send notifications via the WhatsApp Business API.
  • ✅ Webhook Triggers: Send reminder data to any URL for Zapier, Slack, or custom apps.
  • ✅ Notification History & Logging: Keep a detailed, timestamped log of every email sent, failed, or opened.
  • ✅ Saved Email Templates: Create, save, and load unlimited email templates for your notifications.
  • ✅ Actionable Emails: Include a “Mark as Complete” link directly in reminder emails.
  • ✅ Multiple Recipients: Send a single notification to a list of client emails.
  • ✅ Priority Support: Get faster, dedicated email support from our team.

Stop worrying about what’s next. Go Pro to put your reminders on autopilot and let them work for you!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dizetech-reminder folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the new “Reminders” menu in your WordPress admin to get started!
sections.faq:
How are my reminder emails sent?

This plugin uses the built-in WordPress cron system (WP-Cron) to schedule and send emails. This system relies on visitors to your website to trigger the schedule.

My reminder emails are late! How do I fix this?

This is a common issue with WP-Cron. If your site doesn’t have regular visitors (especially at night), your reminders may be delayed. For 100% reliability, we strongly recommend setting up a server cron job. You can find instructions, the command to use, and a video tutorial link in your Reminders > Settings > Advanced tab.

Can I customize the default email subject and message?

Yes! You can set the default text for both admin and client notifications. Go to Reminders > Settings > Email Templates to set your default subject and message, including placeholders like {event_title} and {event_date}.

How do I import the Admin or Client template when writing a reminder?

On the “Add New Reminder” page, inside any notification box, you will see two buttons: “Import Admin Template” and “Import Client Template”. Clicking these will fill the subject and message fields with the defaults you saved in the settings.

What’s the difference between a Reminder and a Public Event?

A Reminder (free) is a private, one-time notification for you or a client. A Public Event (Pro feature) is an event you want to display on your website, with features like a countdown timer and public registration.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No. This plugin is built to be lightweight. It uses a Custom Post Type, which is the efficient, WordPress-native way to store data. The dashboard queries are optimized and do not run on the front-end of your site.
